title: Binyamin the Righteous, a Tanna of a Baraita
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Bava Batra 11a tells of Binyamin the Righteous, who administered a charity fund. During years of drought a woman asked him for support. He swore, “By the Temple service, the fund is empty,” but supported her with his own money. Later he fell dangerously ill; his death decree was torn up. A teaching says that twenty-two years were added to his life. His oath “By the Temple service” somewhat suggests that he lived during the Temple period. Perhaps he is Binyamin, the official in charge of the ovens.

notes.text: בשני בצורת means during years of drought, not exactly two years. Hyman’s Temple-period inference and possible equation with the ovens official remain tentative.
